What makes a review "The Best"?
If you want to make your review extra helpful for others, try to include these four details:
The Problem: (e.g., "Water damage," "Broken charging port," "Software glitch").
The Speed: (e.g., "Fixed while I waited" or "Done by the next morning").
The Price: You don't have to give the exact amount, but mentioning "Fair pricing" or "No hidden fees" helps a lot.
A Photo: A picture of your "like-new" phone or the shop's storefront makes your review much more credible to Google and other customers.

featured_reviews.name: Shantanu Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this shop to get the glass of my OnePlus 12 replaced. The technician did try his best—he managed to remove a few bubbles during the process, which we appreciated. However, new bubbles appeared right in the middle of the screen after the replacement, which was quite disappointing.

When I raised this issue to the manager, the technician rushed in and started speaking in a loud, rude tone. Shockingly, he also showed big eyes to my wife and spoke to her disrespectfully, which was completely unacceptable. He even started accusing us of misbehaving with other nearby shops—an entirely false claim. We had only asked for prices and moved on politely.

While the repair effort was decent and the manager remained calm and professional throughout, the technician’s aggressive and disrespectful behavior—especially toward my wife—was completely out of line. This seriously affected our overall experience. A little professionalism and basic respect would have gone a long way.
